tools.name: fraud-signals_transaction-velocity-analyze
tools.description: Identify abnormal transaction frequency and amount velocity from caller-supplied histories. Velocity spikes alone are never labeled confirmed fraud. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/fraud-signals/transaction-velocity-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: fraud-signals_synthetic-identity-signal-detect
tools.description: Identify inconsistencies in caller-supplied identity records (sparse profiles, age/postal mismatches, shared contacts). Personal data is masked in responses. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/fraud-signals/synthetic-identity-signal-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: fraud-signals_invoice-fraud-signal-detect
tools.description: Detect potentially manipulated invoices from caller-supplied invoice exports (duplicate numbers, tax anomalies, missing PO). Not confirmed fraud. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/fraud-signals/invoice-fraud-signal-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: fraud-signals_supplier-bank-change-risk
tools.description: Identify suspicious supplier bank-detail changes near invoice timing from caller-supplied records. Bank values are last4-masked. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/fraud-signals/supplier-bank-change-risk. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: fraud-signals_refund-abuse-pattern-detect
tools.description: Detect abnormal refund frequency and amount ratios from caller-supplied payment histories. Refund rate alone is not confirmed fraud. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/fraud-signals/refund-abuse-pattern-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: fraud-signals_chargeback-pattern-analyze
tools.description: Analyze recurring chargeback/dispute patterns from caller-supplied payment records. Elevated rates are indicators, not confirmed fraud. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/fraud-signals/chargeback-pattern-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: fraud-signals_multi-account-fraud-cluster
tools.description: Group potentially related accounts using deterministic overlap of caller-supplied emails, phones, devices, IPs, and payment-instrument last4 values. Linkage is not confirmed fraud. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/fraud-signals/multi-account-fraud-cluster. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms
